conclusion: Below ~60% deleted mtDNA in muscle: the common deletion accumulates with age in normal muscle, so a low fraction is not by itself a finding.
Above ~60% deleted mtDNA in muscle: the range in which single large-scale deletion syndromes present. The threshold is the citation's, not this module's.
No deletion fraction was measured in muscle. Withhold: blood is a poor proxy for a single large-scale deletion, which is often undetectable there.
Below ~70% m.8993T>G: usually no attributable phenotype.
Roughly 70-90% m.8993T>G: NARP is the usual presentation at this load.
Above ~90% m.8993T>G: maternally inherited Leigh syndrome. The same variant, a different disease, decided by the level.
No heteroplasmy fraction was measured for m.8993T>G.
